histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Solid, trabecular, or insular architecture without papillary or well-differentiated follicular features; intermediate between differentiated and anaplastic
histomorphological_subtype.grading: Turin criteria (solid/trabecular/insular growth + convoluted nuclei + mitoses ≥3/10 HPF or tumour necrosis)

tumor_microenvironment.immune_context: Variable; may transition toward inflamed as disease dedifferentiates

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Thyroid follicular epithelial cells with progressive dedifferentiation
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Intermediate on the differentiation continuum between well-differentiated (PTC/FTC) and undifferentiated (ATC)
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: Represents a captured intermediate in the dedifferentiation cascade — accumulation of TP53, TERT, and secondary driver mutations progressively erodes follicular identity
